name: Mirror-NeRF
definition: A neural rendering framework that learns accurate mirror geometry and reflection by unifying the radiance field and tracing rays according to Whitted-style light transport, enabling novel view synthesis and scene manipulation.
summary: Mirror-NeRF is a neural rendering framework that unifies radiance fields with Whitted-style ray tracing to synthesize physically consistent mirror reflections, unlike methods treating reflections as separate scenes.
